_comment: fl_detector_history_size: L-BFGS window N. Paper default is 10.
Higher values give better curvature approximation but use more memory
(O(n * N * d) bytes total). Values of 5-20 are reasonable.
fl_detector_z_score_threshold: Removal threshold in standard deviations
above the mean suspicious score. Lower = more aggressive removal.
NOTE: The paper reports that score distributions become clearly bimodal
around round 60. At 30 rounds (as used in our CIFAR-100 experiments),
a lower threshold (1.5-2.0) is recommended because full score separation
begin_removing_from_round: Warmup rounds. Must be >= 1 to allow L-BFGS
history to accumulate before filtering starts. Recommended: 7-10.
